item.title: Google Updates Gemini AI with New Models and Multi-Tiered Subscription Plans
item.description:
Google Updates Gemini AI with New Models and Multi-Tiered Subscription Plans

Google has updated its AI ecosystem with the introduction of the Gemini 4 model family and a restructured subscription framework. These developments include the launch of the Gemini 4 Argon, Hydrogen, and Carbon models, alongside a new functional design language called Neural Expressive.

⚙️ Subscription Tiers and Model Access

The update introduces three distinct Google AI plans with varying levels of access and usage limits. Users can manage their consumption through limits that refresh every 5 hours until a weekly cap is reached, or by purchasing additional AI credits.

Plan Monthly Cost Usage Limits Model Access
Google AI Plus Not specified 2x higher than Free Gemini 4 Argon, Gemini 4 Hydrogen, Pro model, Flash-Lite
Google AI Pro Not specified 4x higher than Free Access to Pro model features
Google AI Ultra $199.99 20x higher than AI Pro Highest access to Gemini 4 Carbon, Argon, and Hydrogen

🧩 Functional Features

New capabilities focus on both complex task management and creative content generation:

  • Gemini 4 Argon: Built to manage and complete complex tasks from start to finish.
  • Gemini Live: Now integrated into chat sessions, allowing users to switch between talking and typing.
  • Gemini Omni: Functions as a video-focused version of Nano Banana.
  • Neural Expressive: A new functional design language created for the AI era.
  • Creative Reimaging: Users can show Gemini their surroundings and use the phrase “reimagine this” to create new visuals with Nano Banana.
  • Personalized Digest: The platform now offers a Daily Brief to help users start their day.

🚀 Agentic Development and Code

The update includes tools for building and governing autonomous AI entities through Google Antigravity, an agentic development platform. Users can utilize these autonomous agents to write, test, and deploy code. The Google AI Ultra plan provides the highest rate limits to agent models within the Antigravity platform and includes first access to features like Tasks in Gemini.

🌎 Availability and Restrictions

Google has expanded the geographic reach of its AI services, though access is limited to users aged 18 and older for Google AI plans and Gemini for Gmail and Docs.

  • Google AI Plus: Available in more than 160 countries and territories.
  • Google AI Pro and Ultra: Available in more than 150 countries.
  • Project Genie: Available in more than 140 countries.
  • YouTube Premium: The individual plan is available in over 40 countries.
  • Regional Specifics: Access to the Gemini 4 Carbon model and Nano Banana Pro in AI Mode is restricted to select countries.

#Gemini #GoogleAI #AIagents #Gemini4 #MachineLearning

Source: Gemini – Your AI assistant from Google

item.title: Google Launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen as New Free Tier and Search Model
item.description:
Google Launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen as New Free Tier and Search Model

On 12th November 2026, Google launched Gemini 4 Hydrogen, the lowest cost member of the Gemini 4 family. Designed as a high-efficiency execution engine, the model is intended for everyday work and to power AI features within Google Search.

⚙️ Key details

Google describes Hydrogen’s position in their model lineup as a tool for fast, disciplined execution.

  • Model Roles: While teams use Carbon and Argon for deep architectural judgment and designing systems, Hydrogen is built for writing code, running tests, and verifying changes.
  • Workflow Integration: Hydrogen can stand alone for everyday tasks or pair with Carbon and Argon in multi-model workflows.
  • Capabilities: In a comparison of image generation, there is a stark difference in pelican quality for Hydrogen compared to its siblings.
Model Primary Function Performance Notes
Gemini 4 Hydrogen Everyday work, code execution, free tier Intended for fast, disciplined execution
Gemini 4 Carbon Architectural judgment, untangling bugs Frontier model
Gemini 4 Argon Architectural judgment, system design Faster responses and lower token spend than Carbon

💰 Pricing

The pricing for the Gemini 4 family is scheduled to change significantly in the coming month:

  • Current Rates: Hydrogen is currently priced at a 25% discount compared to Carbon and Argon. Carbon and Argon are currently the same price.
  • Scheduled Increases: On December 1st, the price of Carbon and Argon is scheduled to double.
  • Future Discount: After December 1st, the Hydrogen price will represent a 75% discount relative to its more capable peers.
  • Market Comparison: At 15x the cost of Claude Haiku 5.5 and GPT-6 Luna (which are both $0.10/$0.50), Hydrogen remains considerably more expensive than competing low-cost models.

🚀 Availability

Hydrogen is available immediately as the new model for Google’s free tier. It is also the specific model designated to power AI features in Google Search.

#Google #Gemini4 #ArtificialIntelligence #MachineLearning #SearchAI

Source: Release: llm-gemini 0.37

item.title: Google Announces Gemini 4 Argon Frontier Model for Complex Workflows
item.description:
Google Announces Gemini 4 Argon Frontier Model for Complex Workflows

Google has announced Gemini 4 Argon, a new frontier model designed to sustain deep reasoning across complex, long-horizon workflows. The model is currently rolling out to a set of trusted cyber defenders through the Fairwind Program.

🔍 Overview

Gemini 4 Argon is designed for frontier performance in real-world software engineering, cybersecurity defense, and enterprise knowledge work, such as finance and legal. Internally, thousands of Googlers are using the model for specialized coding tasks, writing quality, and deeper research.

⚙️ Key Details

To support complex use cases, Google has expanded the model’s output token limit to 1M tokens, increasing it from the previous 64K tokens. This allows the model to generate hundreds of thousands of tokens in a single trajectory to solve difficult problems.

Pricing:

  • Input tokens: $2 per million
  • Output tokens: $10 per million
  • Cached input tokens: 95% off the input token price

💡 Why it matters

Argon has demonstrated performance across several specialized benchmarks and real-world applications:

  • Software Engineering: Sets a new state of the art on DeepSWE v1.1 (77.9%).
  • Economic Impact: Leads the Vals Index (finance, coding, legal, and tax work), as well as Vals Finance Agent v2 and Harvey’s Legal Agent Benchmark.
  • Business Execution: Ranks #1 on AutomationBench with a score of 51.3%.
  • Video Understanding: Achieves state of the art on LVBench with a score of 91.7%.
  • Cybersecurity: Ties for first place on CWE-bench v1 (68%) and can autonomously find, validate, and patch critical software vulnerabilities.

Internal Google Implementations:

  • Quantum Computing: Optimized spacetime resources for subroutines, beating a published baseline by 40% in minutes.
  • Data Center Optimization: Argon agents identified memory optimizations that freed over 300 TiB of memory, with total estimated savings between 500 TiB and 1 PiB.
  • Code Migration: Migrating C/C++ codebases to Rust, ranging from core libraries like re2 and libgav1 up to 800K+ lines for the Fuchsia Zircon kernel. For libgav1, Argon produced a memory-safe video decoder that runs 2.7x faster than the previous Rust port.

🚀 Availability

Because of the level of frontier capabilities, Google is using a phased release approach:

  • Cyber Defenders: Available through the Fairwind Program. Trusted defenders and internal Google teams receive the model without cyber guardrails to leverage full defense capabilities. Wiz is currently using the model for its Scan for Good initiative.
  • General Release: The model will be made available to developers, enterprises, and consumers after further iteration on guardrails based on early tester feedback.

#Gemini4 #Google #Cybersecurity #SoftwareEngineering #AI

Source: Gemini 4 Argon: our next era of frontier intelligence

item.title: Google DeepMind Nears Launch of Gemini 4 Frontier AI Model
item.description:
Google DeepMind Nears Launch of Gemini 4 Frontier AI Model

Google is preparing to launch Gemini 4, a new frontier AI model, following a period of leadership changes and a shift in release strategy.

⚙️ Key details

Koray Kavukcuoglu, the new leader of Google’s DeepMind division, has provided the following updates regarding the model:

  • Current Status: The model is in its refinement stage.
  • Release Goal: Google aims to launch the model “much earlier” than the end of the year and “long before the end of 2026.”
  • Development Approach: The company intends to release an “early post-training output” as soon as possible and intends to “continue the fast-paced iterations” moving forward.

💡 Why it matters

This development follows a period where Google trailed rival developers on flagship releases. Key context includes:

  • Competitive Landscape: OpenAI’s GPT-6 and Anthropic’s Mythos series have launched since November 2025, and both outperform Gemini 3.
  • Previous Releases: Google’s last flagship AI model was the Gemini 3 series in November 2025. A planned Gemini 3.5 Pro update for June was never rolled out because the company “took a little bit of a step back” to prioritize faster, less powerful Flash models.
  • Leadership Changes: Former AI head Demis Hassabis stepped down in August after stating that “great progress” was being made on Gemini 4.

When asked about falling behind rivals, Kavukcuoglu stated, “In my mind, it’s a certainty that we are always gonna be at the frontier.”

#Google #DeepMind #Gemini4 #ArtificialIntelligence

Source: Gemini 4 is almost ready, says new Google DeepMind chief
